method: Three event-specific first-pass research passes: 22 events in the initial evidence crosswalk (11 rewritten), 20 additional checked and rewritten in the second pass, and 20 additional checked and rewritten on 27 October 2026 in the third pass. The 62 crosswalks are based on published Formula 1 event reports, stewards summaries, official classification or historical retrospectives as described per event; they are not independent editorial sign-offs. Full source uptime, FIA PDF decisions, photo rights, historical turn geometry and all 105 claim-level approvals have NOT been established. Fourth pass: 26 additional event-specific F1 source pages opened and relevant passages inspected, with 12 bilingual narratives rewritten. First-party retrospectives are not original FIA decisions. No independent editorial approval, historic geometry or media clearance. Fifth pass: remaining 17 race-specific first-pass crosswalks based on inspected F1 reports, an Autosport contemporaneous report and Bridgestone manufacturer statements; 8 further bilingual rewrites. First-pass event evidence does not constitute independent claim-level review.
